earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
highlights: Q4 GAAP EPS of $1.60; Q4 Adjusted EPS* of $1.66*

CORK, Ireland — October 27, 2026 — Johnson Controls International plc (NYSE: JCI), a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, is proud to announce fiscal fourth quarter 2026 GAAP earnings per share (“EPS”) of $1.60.
Q4 sales increased 10% and organic sales increased 12%*
Backlog of $23.0 billion increased 43% organically year-over-year

quotes.text: We finished fiscal 2026 with significant momentum, delivering more than 8% organic revenue growth, double-digit adjusted EPS growth and strong free cash flow conversion.
quotes.by: Joakim Weidemanis, Chief Executive Officer of Johnson Controls

items.heading: Our future growth is dependent upon our ability to develop or acquire new products, services and technologies that achieve market acceptance with acceptable margins.
